coordination.claudeLastCompleted: Focus Plan polished into a calmer, smarter work buddy (building on Codex's Focus Plan), inside all existing Focus Plan invariants (no new store/API/payload/chatbot/standing block). The FocusPlanModal When pill now preserves real timing (whenLabel) and only appends the minute estimate as a hint. Reply/follow-up items surface a real send-timing window via the existing deriveSendTimingHint when the contact has a confident inbound band and the current hour is outside it. Owed promises (contact-memory openCommitments of kind promise, honouring dismissedCommitmentIds) are a new plan source ranked just below reply-now and deduped by contact, routed through the existing follow-up handler. The Daily Brief recommendation (buildWorkbenchRecommendation) and Focus Plan (buildFocusPlan) now share one ranking core, collectHeadWorkSignals in leadWorkSignal.ts, so their top item can never disagree. Orchestration was extracted from FloatingAssistant.tsx into the useFocusPlan hook (planner build + action router + promise/badge derivations); the inline 94-line handleFocusPlanItem is gone and the host shrank 3,299 to 3,252 lines. The modal gained Escape/backdrop close, focus-on-open + focus trap, a full-width Start here, larger fonts, and a warm all-caught-up clear state; the action badge still excludes the clear item. Visual follow-up: Focus Plan must open without a blur/dim overlay and without custom Electron panel width; setPanelOpen remains (open: boolean). Restored the documented const shouldShowReferralNudge = false action-count guard that was missing. New EN/ZH focusPlan keys: whenAround, clockTime, timeAm, timePm, promiseTitle, promiseReason. Verified: verify:focus-plan, verify:next-step, verify:contact-continuity, verify:smart-reply, build --workspace=apps/web, electron:build.
